reference.about: The master data sheet (track MP, design handover/design/SSE4-matter-pack-design.md): constants of nature, conventions, reference objects, elements, isotopes, substances and mixtures, each value with its source. Built by scripts/build-base-reference.py; MP2 first wave. A value without "check" is verified against its source; "unverified" means the source is named but the number was not read from it; "authored" is a documented stand-in (docs/fudges.md).

sources.text: A spherically symmetric atom has no anisotropic polarisability, so its King correction factor is exactly 1 (Bodhaine et al. 1999 discussion of depolarisation)

10th CGPM 1954, Resolution 4: standard atmosphere 101 325 Pa
Tiesinga, E., Mohr, P. J., Newell, D. B. and Taylor, B. N. 2021, Rev. Mod. Phys. 93, 025010: CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants, 2018
Elements in their standard state and the hydrogen ion at unit activity have zero free energy and enthalpy of formation by convention
SSE4 fudge register: an authored stand-in kept because no measured value fits (reason in docs/fudges.md)
IAU 2012 Resolution B2: re-definition of the astronomical unit of length, 149 597 870 700 m exactly
IAU 2015 Resolution B2: the parsec is 648000/π au
